switches.label: Estimated session cost
switches.description: Show what the open session has cost so far, priced from recorded usage at the published DeepSeek rates.

switches.label: Account balance
switches.description: Show the remaining account balance in the sidebar foot, above the account row.

switches.label: Open workspace folder
switches.description: Add an “Open workspace folder” row to a Session’s menu that opens its workspace in the file browser.

switches.label: Add a workspace from GitHub
switches.description: Sign in with the GitHub CLI, browse your repositories, and clone one as a workspace.

switches.label: Add a workspace from this PC or GitHub
switches.description: Put an On this PC / GitHub repository source menu behind the Workspaces + button.

switches.label: Right-panel screenshot
switches.description: Copy the open right panel into the chat as an image, and onto the clipboard.

switches.label: Better workspace
switches.description: Replace the sidebar workspace list with our own tree: workspaces with their sessions, a right-click menu on a workspace (open, copy path, remove), and the shipped session menu inside it.

switches.label: Session trash
switches.description: Move an archived session’s transcript to a trash you can restore from, and empty it when you want the space back.

switches.label: Arya Standard preset
switches.description: Add the Arya Standard agent preset, with Codex checkpoint compaction and its own Compaction tab.

switches.label: MCP servers
switches.description: Add and manage Model Context Protocol servers from Settings → MCP servers.

switches.label: Cross-session memory
switches.description: Keep short notes across sessions. Recalled into the system prompt as quoted context, and managed from Settings → Memory.

switches.label: Lifecycle hooks
switches.description: Run a command when a turn stops, a session errors, or a checkpoint lands. Rules live in polish/hooks.json; Settings → Hooks lists and validates them.

switches.label: AryaSearch provider
switches.description: Search through your own SearXNG instance, so web_search keeps working without a DeepSeek key.
